up: Retrieve the ChEMBL ID, exact IC50 value in nM, PubMed ID or DOI, and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the human CB1 cannabinoid receptor (target CHEMBL218). Filter for exact IC50 measurements (standard_relation = '=') with units in nM. Only include rows where the compound has a valid SMILES string and the associated document has a PubMed ID or a DOI. Return one row per qualifying activity.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS chembl_id, a.standard_value AS ic50_nM, COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi, cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL218' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL AND (d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR d.doi IS NOT NULL)
